title: TwinCAT MCP coding guidelines (.twincat-mcp.json)
description: Coding guidelines the TwinCAT MCP server enforces for a solution. The file lives next to the .sln. Comments and trailing commas are allowed.

strings.description: A string or a list of alternatives.

extends.description: Base file this one builds on: a path relative to this file, or 'builtin:<name>' for a shipped example (builtin:beckhoff, builtin:syntegon). Objects merge key by key, other values (arrays too) are replaced.

name.description: Name of the guideline, shown by guidelines_get and solution_open.

guide.description: Markdown style guide (path relative to this file). Served as resource twincat://guide/st-conventions.

defaultSeverity.description: Severity of configured rules that 'rules' does not list. Default: warn.

exclude.description: Wildcard patterns (* ?) for objects/identifiers no rule applies to: object name, tree path, identifier or Object.Identifier.

rules.description: Severity per rule key. Patterns 'naming.*', 'decl.*', '*' set every matching rule (except naming.unknownType).

compositePrefixes.description: ARRAY/POINTER/REFERENCE prefixes concatenate from outer to inner (default true).

typePrefixes.description: Prefix per data type name (BOOL, LREAL, ...) and per wrapper (ARRAY, POINTER, REFERENCE).

kindPrefixes.description: Prefix for variables of user-defined types by kind; the kind comes from typeKinds.

types.description: Prefix per type name or wildcard pattern (TON, MC_*). Exact names win over patterns; checked before typePrefixes and typeKinds.

templates.description: Name template per category: literal text plus {type}, {Name} (PascalCase), {name}, {NAME} (UPPER_SNAKE), {*} (free). '@' starts a regex that may use the same tokens.

requiredAttributes.description: Attributes a declaration must carry per object kind, e.g. { "ENUM": ["qualified_only", "strict"] }.

extensionMin.description: Values from here on are local extensions named <ENUM>_<VALUE>.

templates.description: Template files (relative to this file). Placeholders: {name} {kind} {parent} {date} {year} {description}.

assign.description: Which template a new object gets (first match wins).

parent.description: Regex on the owning POU's name (methods, actions).

copyright.description:
Text every header must contain (whitespace and
ignored).

description.description: Keyword that must be followed by a description, e.g. DESCRIPTION.

descriptionPlaceholder.description: What {description} becomes on create; a description still starting with it counts as missing.

autoFix.description: Fixes applied when an object is created (never to existing code, never renames).
